units.source_text: 黑133再断白三子另一方，叫吃三子，然后直到黑139，连续叫吃，挺进一线，发生了如大竹七段所说的“惊天动地”的逆转。

en.t: With Black 133, Black cuts again on the other side of White's three stones, puts three stones in atari, and then, through Black 139, keeps giving atari after atari, pushing forward to the first line; there occurs the earth-shaking reversal that 7-dan Otake described.

units.source_text: 黑子直闯白模样的正中央。

en.t: The black stones drive straight into the very center of White's framework.

units.source_text: 我仿佛听见了白阵哗然溃败的声音。

en.t: I seemed to hear the sound of White's formation collapsing in an uproar.
